verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Pro is a silicon chip (SoC), not software a user operates, so being operated by natural-language commands is the wrong axis for this kind of product. The mentions of Apple Intelligence models running faster on the chip describe how quickly software runs on it, not a natural-language control interface the chip itself ships. No evidence shows the chip itself provides such a capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
